t.why: The sea gateway for East Africa's landlocked countries.
t.rel: A member of the East African Community; goods for landlocked neighbors such as Rwanda, Burundi, Uganda and Zambia pass through the port of Dar es Salaam. It disagrees with Malawi over the boundary on Lake Malawi and joins in responding to the insurgency in northern Mozambique.
t.know: It has Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest mountain.
t.etext: Gold, cashews, coffee and tourism are the main sources of income. The port of Dar es Salaam is the gateway for landlocked countries.
